_comment: Excel tracker column mapping — configuration, not code, so a new column is a settings change. The target must be a real named Excel table (see docs/IT-REQUEST.md for the one-time client change). Keys are metadata fields; values are the exact column headers in the tracker. The header row is validated on every append; drift raises an alert instead of writing into the wrong column silently.
workbookPath: [CONFIRM: path within the tenant, e.g. /sites/PS-Confidential/Shared Documents/Tracker.xlsx]
